name: deals-n-discounts
description: Deals N' Discounts is a full stack e-commerce application. Users can browse products, search different categories, add items to a cart, and order items in their cart. Once ordered, the items stock is updated in the database. This project was developed for Millersville University's CMSC 421(Advanced Web Development).
author: Collin Donnan, John Hershey, Jacob Karasow, Ian Swartz
